1.name: Whispering Woods
1.boss_text: The Bandit Chief waits by the fire, axe in hand.
1.intro: Monsters stir in the hills. Driven out by them, bandits now raid the villages of the Whispering Woods. Their chief has made camp past the old road. Stop him.
1.intro_retry: Back to the Whispering Woods. The bandits are still out there.
1.outro: "They pay us in shards..." the Bandit Chief gasps. "...the hills are cracking."

2.name: Frostfang Peaks
2.boss_text: Vharn the Frost Tyrant waits on a throne of ice, a blue crystal humming behind him.
2.intro: The road north climbs into the Frostfang Peaks. Soldiers who went up the passes never came back. Something up there keeps them, frozen and obedient.
2.intro_retry: Back into the Frostfang Peaks. The cold is waiting.
2.outro: "Three more locks, little key," Vharn rasps as the ice cracks. "Then you will wish for my cold."
